title: Horizon Europe Cluster 5 onsite brokerage event
summary: An onsite networking and brokerage session held after the Cluster 5 Info Day, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the same venue.
details: Only attendees accepted for onsite participation at the Info Day can join, and onsite places are limited.
why: Worth planning alongside the Info Day if you need a partner for a 2027 proposal. Because access depends on an onsite place, check your Info Day registration first.
